method: Editorial judgments by one assistant using distinct review passes, not independent referee consensus or probabilities of acceptance.

rows.principal_finding: All 12 numbered formal results were reconstructed; the degree theorem now has a universal factor-divisibility proof. No remaining counterexample found under the stated contracts.
Complete proofs include connectedness, both quartic degree lower bounds, fixed/adaptive coordinate costs, and direct LM faithfulness. Remark 2.3 is checked separately.
Nonempty guards, zero-free promises, predicate libraries, fixed coordinates, adaptive access, and arithmetic costs are now distinguished.
The exact case-study tradeoff is a candidate distinctive calculation, not priority-cleared new theory. General ingredients have explicit antecedents.
A coherent worked example demonstrates observation-contract dependence; no broader application or asymptotic algorithmic benefit is established.
Primary-source comparisons include test sets, predicate minimization, sign geometry, polynomial descriptions, DSGRN, and two verified 2026 preprints.
Exact rational and integer tests, symbolic prerequisites, historical reruns, portable commands, and a relocated byte-identical run are delivered.
Abstract, theorem hypotheses, implementation behavior, observation counts, and evidence descriptions now agree.
The supplied prior objections are mapped individually. Portability and contract gaps are repaired; the demand for a substantial new research contribution remains conditional.
One nonlinear example now carries the argument; a worked CM-to-LM endpoint and explicit failure cases make the contracts concrete.
The degree tradeoff is central. Walsh and trajectory results are supporting classical appendices, not competing headline claims.
Claims have matching proofs or clearly bounded tests; classical claims have primary references. Literature search remains finite and some publisher full texts were inaccessible.
Clean, buildable 14-page PDF with metadata and resolved citations; author identity/contact details and venue-specific declarations still require author confirmation.
Conditionally suitable as a focused mathematical methods/expository note, not justified as a broad new-theory or performance paper.

decision: Conditional GO as a focused methods note after author/venue checks; NO unqualified GO as a substantial new-theory research article.
hard_gate: A serious correctness, unsupported-priority, or evidence-integrity problem overrides the weighted average.
